Definition: neuter of a derivative of σάνδαλον (a "sandal"; of uncertain origin); a slipper or sole-pad:--sandal.
BiblicalUsage: Sandálion names of uncertain origin); a slipper or sole-pad. It stands in Acts 12:8, "…angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind…", and in Mark 6:9, "But shod with sandals; and not put on…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sandálion is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
